description.en: The nucleophile attacks from the side opposite to the leaving group. The transition state shows carbon bonded to five atoms partially. As the leaving group departs, the molecule flips like an umbrella turning inside out in a strong wind, resulting in Walden inversion.
description.hi: नाभिकरागी अवशिष्ट समूह (leaving group) के विपरीत दिशा से आक्रमण करता है। संक्रमण अवस्था कार्बन को आंशिक रूप से पांच परमाणुओं से जुड़ा हुआ दिखाती है। जैसे ही अवशिष्ट समूह निकलता है, अणु तेज हवा में उल्टी होने वाली छतरी की तरह पलट जाता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप वाल्डन प्रतिलोमन होता है।
description.hinglish: Nucleophile leaving group ke opposite side se attack karta hai. Transition state mein carbon partially paanch atoms se bonded dikhta hai. Jaise hi leaving group nikalta hai, molecule tez hawa mein ulte hue umbrella ki tarah flip ho jata hai, jise Walden inversion kehte hain.

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Reactants -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 100)">
    <!-- Nucleophile -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="50" r="15" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="0" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">Nu</text>
    <text x="15" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">-</text>
    
    <!-- Arrow showing attack -->
    <path d="M 25 50 Q 50 20 80 40" fill="none" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

    <!-- Substrate -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="50" r="20" fill="#4b5563" /> <!-- Carbon -->
    <text x="110" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
    
    <line x1="110" y1="30" x2="110" y2="10" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" /> <!-- Top bond -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="0" r="10" fill="#10b981" />
    
    <path d="M 100 65 L 80 90 L 95 95 Z" fill="#3b82f6" /> <!-- Wedge -->
    <circle cx="85" cy="95" r="10" fill="#3b82f6" />
    
    <!-- Dash -->
    <line x1="120" y1="65" x2="130" y2="90" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="4,2" />
    <circle cx="135" cy="95" r="10" fill="#f59e0b" />
    
    <!-- Leaving group -->
    <line x1="130" y1="50" x2="160" y2="50" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" />
    <circle cx="175" cy="50" r="15" fill="#8b5cf6" />
    <text x="175" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">X</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Transition State -->
  <g transform="translate(300, 100)">
    <text x="75" y="-30" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">[ Transition State ]</text>
    <!-- Brackets -->
    <path d="M 0 -20 L -10 -20 L -10 120 L 0 120" fill="none" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" />
    <path d="M 150 -20 L 160 -20 L 160 120 L 150 120" fill="none" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="165" y="-10" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#4b5563">‡</text>

    <!-- Central Carbon -->
    <circle cx="75" cy="50" r="20" fill="#4b5563" />
    <text x="75" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
    
    <!-- Planar groups -->
    <line x1="75" y1="30" x2="75" y2="10" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" />
    <circle cx="75" cy="0" r="10" fill="#10b981" />
    
    <path d="M 65 65 L 50 100 L 65 105 Z" fill="#3b82f6" />
    <circle cx="55" cy="105" r="10" fill="#3b82f6" />
    
    <line x1="85" y1="65" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="4,2" />
    <circle cx="100" cy="105" r="10" fill="#f59e0b" />

    <!-- Partial bonds -->
    <line x1="55" y1="50" x2="20" y2="50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <circle cx="5" cy="50" r="15" fill="#ef4444" opacity="0.5" />
    <text x="5" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.5">Nu</text>
    <text x="-15" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444">-δ</text>

    <line x1="95" y1="50" x2="130" y2="50" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <circle cx="145" cy="50" r="15" fill="#8b5cf6" opacity="0.5" />
    <text x="145" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.5">X</text>
    <text x="165" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#8b5cf6">-δ</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Products -->
  <g transform="translate(550, 100)">
    <!-- Central Carbon -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="20" fill="#4b5563" />
    <text x="50" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
    
    <!-- Flipped groups -->
    <line x1="50" y1="30" x2="50" y2="10" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="4" />
    <circle cx="50" cy="0" r="10" fill="#10b981" />
    
    <path d="M 60 65 L 80 90 L 65 95 Z" fill="#3b82f6" />
    <circle cx="75" cy="95" r="10" fill="#3b82f6" />
    
    <line x1="40" y1="65" x2="30" y2="90" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="4,2" />
    <circle cx="25" cy="95" r="10" fill="#f59e0b" />

    <!-- New bond to Nu -->
    <line x1="30" y1="50" x2="0" y2="50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="4" />
    <circle cx="-15" cy="50" r="15" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="-15" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">Nu</text>

    <!-- Leaving group departs -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="50" r="15" fill="#8b5cf6" />
    <text x="110" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">X</text>
    <text x="125" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#8b5cf6">-</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow markers def -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#2563eb" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
